description: Walks the graph several hops out from a thought. Call it when you need to see the whole neighbourhood: which region of the brain adjoins a topic, where new material should slot in, what already sits nearby. Viewing a thought shows one hop only.

brainId.description: Brain identifier. Take it from brain_list — never guess it.

follow.description: Which link kinds to follow. All of them by default.
